summary: perf(settings): lazy-load scoped-keys in the OAuth finish hook
description:
Because:

- The OAuth finish hook imported scoped-keys statically, so node-jose and
  node-forge shipped with every page that imports the hook.

This commit:

- Loads createEncryptedBundle with a dynamic import in constructKeysJwe.
- Prefetches the module on mount for Sync and for OAuth with keysJwk.
- Adds tests for a chunk-load failure (TRY_AGAIN) and for the prefetch.

Closes FXA-14854
